transcript.text: Thanks for joining the planning huddle. As you both know, the operations and employee-support teams currently run separate weekly forums on the same afternoon, and employees have flagged that the agendas overlap. I have the authority to consolidate these into a single recurring format and set its operating rules, but before I make anything binding, I want to understand the practical constraints. So let's start with the basics: what scheduling limitations, format preferences, or other logistical issues should I be aware of from each of your perspectives?
